newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close the week lower.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close the week lower.

text.p: Croatian stocks mostly dipped on Friday on slightly smaller volume and turnover.
* Nine of 15 active issues fell, four rose and two were flat.
* Volume slightly lower at 10,704 shares, turnover also down at five million kuna.
* Top gainer hotelier Zlatni rat added 40 kuna to 150, selling 55 units in a first deal since last October.
* Biggest loser electrical group Koncar Elektroindustrija tumbled 245 kuna to 905, but only 21 shares were sold.
* Most active drugs firm Pliva inched up four kuna to 425 on volume of 5,342 shares.
